title: Playboy: Night Calls
overview: For the first time on video it's Night Calls - Playboy TV's erotic, phone-in talk show where anything goes. See for yourself as Night Calls' two sexy hostesses, Juli and Doria, entice callers to share erotic experiences of their own. These uninhibited hostesses are ready to turn up the heat and act out viewers' fantasies live on each show. Juli and Doria draw from their own experiences to make sure everyone is more than satisfied by the time the show ends.
